messages.text:
The compact help now mirrors the reference.

I’m doing a broader sweep of edge cases: invalid numeric values, charset files, start offsets, mask custom charsets, not-found searches, and archives without encrypted entries.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, re, sys, os, zipfile, tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); ref=pathlib.Path(root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); py=[sys.executable, str(root/'executable')]
# prepare helper files
(root/'plain.txt').write_text('hello')
with zipfile.ZipFile(root/'plain.zip','w') as z: z.write(root/'plain.txt','plain.txt')
(root/'dict_small.txt').write_text('zz\\nab\\n', newline='')
(root/'chars.txt').write_text('ba')
cases=[
 ['-h'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--workers','abc'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--fileNumber','abc'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--maxPasswordLen','1','--workers','1','-c','l'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '-c','l','--minPasswordLen','2','--maxPasswordLen','2','-s','ba','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--charsetFile',str(root/'chars.txt'),'--maxPasswordLen','2','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '-m','?1?d','--customCharset1','a?l','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '-m','','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--mask','?1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '-p',str(root/'dict_small.txt'),'--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'plain.zip')],
 ['--bad'],
]
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'Time elapsed: .*', 'Time elapsed: <time>', s)
for args in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref,*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
 p=subprocess.run(py+args,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and norm(r.stdout)==norm(p.stdout) and r.stderr==p.stderr)
 print('OK' if ok else 'DIFF', args)
 if not ok:
  print('ref',r.returncode,repr(norm(r.stdout)),repr(r.stderr))
  print('py ',p.returncode,repr(norm(p.stdout)),repr(p.stderr))
  print()
'@ | python -"
